invariants.rationale: The method always returns an Iterator, either from Collections.singletonList(...).iterator() or from new JavaLazyInsertIterable<>(...). Both are guaranteed non-null.
idPfx is passed directly to JavaLazyInsertIterable and likely required to be non-null.
If recordItr is not empty, the method returns an instance of JavaLazyInsertIterable. Otherwise, returns the singleton iterator.
If the input iterator is empty, then the result iterator yields an empty list as its only element. Otherwise, result is non-empty.
The returned object is always an Iterator.
